source_text: The Ashley Montagu Resolution explicitly requests all national governments to petition the International Court of Justice (World Court) in The Hague to issue a declaratory judgment affirming that non-therapeutic genital mutilations of children violate key provisions of the United Nations Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child.
